schema.lane: string (Visual Vertical. Values: see VALID_LANES in system/lib/types.py. Ex: 'STOCK')
schema.expectation: string (Inert Success Criteria. Ex: 'Returns raw OHLCV data.')
schema.instruction: optional string (Usually empty for tools, but allowed for loader tag injection)
schema.teleology: optional string (Architectural Intent. 1 sentence summary for Dashboard.)
schema.mechanism: optional string (Method of Action. ~4 sentences for Dashboard.)

meta.is_feed: optional boolean (Live/Lab Toggle. PHYSICS. Ex: true)
